subject: Mathematics
prompt: Standard equation of ellipse with major axis along x-axis?
explain: When a > b, major axis is along x-axis; semi-major = a, semi-minor = b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Eccentricity relation for ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b)?
explain: For ellipse, 0 < e < 1 and b² = a²(1 - e²) defines the relationship.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Foci of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b) are at?
explain: Foci lie on the major axis at distance ae from centre, so (±ae, 0).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Length of major axis of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b)?
explain: Major axis spans from (−a, 0) to (a, 0), so its length is 2a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Length of latus rectum of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1?
explain: Latus rectum is the chord through focus perpendicular to major axis; length = 2b²/a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Sum of focal distances of any point P on ellipse equals?
explain: This is the focal-chord (definition) property: sum of distances from two foci = 2a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Directrices of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b) are?
explain: Directrices are vertical lines at x = ±a/e for major axis along x-axis.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of tangent to x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 at point (x₁, y₁)?
explain: T = 0 form: replace x² → xx₁, y² → yy₁ in ellipse equation.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Condition for y = mx + c to be tangent to x²/a² + y²/b² = 1?
explain: Tangent condition: substitute y = mx + c into ellipse and discriminant = 0 gives c² = a²m² + b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of normal to x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 at point (x₁, y₁)?
explain: Normal at (x₁,y₁): a²x/x₁ − b²y/y₁ = a² − b² (= a²e²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Auxiliary circle of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 has equation?
explain: Auxiliary circle has radius = semi-major axis a, centred at origin.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Parametric equations of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1?
formula: x = a cosθ, y = b sinθ
options: x = a cosθ, y = a sinθ
x = a secθ, y = b tanθ
x = a sinθ, y = b cosθ
x = a cosθ, y = b sinθ
explain: Standard parametric form uses eccentric angle θ: (a cosθ, b sinθ).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Tangent at parametric point (a cosθ, b sinθ) on ellipse?
explain: Substitute (a cosθ, b sinθ) into T = 0 form: x cosθ/a + y sinθ/b = 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Director circle of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 has equation?
explain: Locus of point from which two perpendicular tangents to ellipse are drawn is x² + y² = a² + b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Eccentricity range for an ellipse is?
explain: For ellipse eccentricity satisfies 0 < e < 1; e = 0 gives circle, e = 1 gives parabola.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 with b > a, foci are at?
explain: When b > a, major axis is along y-axis; foci at (0, ±be) where e = √(1 − a²/b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Area of ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 is?
explain: Area of ellipse = π × semi-major × semi-minor = πab.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Chord of contact from external point (h,k) to x²/a² + y²/b² = 1?
explain: Chord of contact (T = 0) from (h, k): replace x₁ = h, y₁ = k in tangent equation.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Focal chord: if one end of focal chord has parameter t₁, other end t₂?
formula: t₁·t₂ = −1 (for parabola); for ellipse: t₁t₂ = −b²/a²? No—correct: e·t relation
explain: The product t₁t₂ = −1 is specific to parabola; ellipse focal chord has a different relation.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: End-points of latus rectum of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b) are?
explain: Foci at x = ±ae; substituting gives y² = b²(1 − e²) = b⁴/a², so y = ±b²/a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Pair of tangents from (h,k) to ellipse — combined equation uses?
explain: Joint equation of pair of tangents from external point: SS₁ = T², where S, T, S₁ are standard.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The chord joining (a cosα, b sinα) and (a cosβ, b sinβ) on ellipse?
explain: Standard result for chord joining two parametric points on ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, if e is eccentricity and l is semi-latus rectum, then l = ?
explain: Semi-latus rectum = b²/a, and since b² = a²(1−e²), it equals a(1−e²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Reflection property: ray from one focus reflects off ellipse and passes through?
explain: Optical property of ellipse: every ray from one focus reflects to pass through the other focus.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Which of these represents an ellipse? (a, b > 0, a ≠ b)
explain: Sum of two squared terms equal to 1 with different denominators gives an ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Minor axis length of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b) is?
explain: Minor axis lies along y-axis with length 2b when a > b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Distance from centre to focus of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b)?
explain: Focal distance from centre is c = ae, where e is eccentricity.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Relation between a, b, c for ellipse (a > b, c = focal dist)?
explain: For ellipse b² = a²(1 − e²) = a² − c², fundamental relation.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1, what is the semi-latus rectum?
explain: Semi-latus rectum = b²/a; full latus rectum = 2b²/a.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Slope of normal to x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 at (x₁,y₁)?
explain: Tangent slope = −b²x₁/(a²y₁), so normal slope = a²y₁/(b²x₁). Wait — normal slope is −1/tangent slope = a²y₁/(b²x₁). Correct answer is index 3.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Normal to ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 at (x₁,y₁): which is correct?
explain: Normal at (x₁,y₁): a²x/x₁ − b²y/y₁ = a² − b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of normal to ellipse at parametric point (a cosθ, b sinθ)?
explain: Normal at (a cosθ, b sinθ): ax/cosθ − by/sinθ = a² − b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Number of normals that can be drawn from an external point to ellipse?
explain: At most 4 normals can be drawn from an external point to an ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The eccentric angle φ relates point on ellipse to auxiliary circle how?
options: P=(cosφ, sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(b cosφ, a sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), Q=(b cosφ, b sinφ)
P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), Q=(a cosφ, a sinφ)
explain: Eccentric angle φ: ellipse point P=(a cosφ, b sinφ), auxiliary circle point Q has same x, y=a sinφ.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, product of perpendiculars from foci on any tangent is?
explain: Product of perpendiculars from two foci to any tangent of ellipse equals b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The foot of perpendicular from focus to any tangent of ellipse lies on?
explain: Foot of perpendicular from either focus to any tangent lies on the auxiliary circle x²+y²=a².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: What is the condition for point (h, k) to lie inside ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1?
explain: Point (h,k) is inside ellipse iff h²/a² + k²/b² < 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Tangent to x²/a² + y²/b²=1 with slope m has y-intercept?
explain: Tangent y=mx±√(a²m²+b²); intercept magnitude = √(a²m²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The locus of midpoints of focal chords of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is?
explain: Locus of midpoints of focal chords is itself an ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1, the ratio (distance from focus)/(distance from directrix) for any point is?
explain: Focus-directrix property: focal distance / directrix distance = e (eccentricity).

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If e₁ and e₂ are eccentricities of an ellipse and its conjugate hyperbola, then?
explain: For ellipse & its conjugate hyperbola: 1/e₁² + 1/e₂² = 1.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The angle subtended by a latus rectum at centre of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 depends on?
explain: Latus rectum endpoints are (±ae, ±b²/a); subtended angle involves both a and b.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Equation of ellipse with foci (±c, 0) and sum of focal distances = 2a is?
explain: With b²=a²−c², standard form is x²/a²+y²/b²=1 where b²=a²−c².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Conjugate diameters of ellipse: if slope of one diameter is m₁, other m₂ satisfies?
explain: Two diameters are conjugate if m₁·m₂ = −b²/a².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: If the ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 passes through (1,2) and (2,1), then?
options: a²≠b², it's an ellipse not a circle
explain: 1/a²+4/b²=1 and 4/a²+1/b²=1 give a²=b² only if symmetric — generally a≠b giving a true ellipse.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: The sum of squares of semi-axes of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 equals?
explain: Semi-axes are a and b; sum of squares is simply a²+b².

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Distance between two directrices of ellipse x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b) is?
explain: Directrices at x=±a/e, so distance between them = 2a/e.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Distance between two foci of x²/a²+y²/b²=1 (a>b) is?
explain: Foci at (±ae, 0), so distance between them = 2ae.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: For ellipse, the tangent at end of major axis is?
explain: At vertex (a,0), tangent is x=a, which is perpendicular to the major axis (x-axis).
